ideas.title: Following the Money in Healthcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of healthcare fraud cases, including the Feeding Our Future trial and the Medicaid investigation.
questions: What are the financial implications of healthcare fraud?
How can financial analysis be used to prevent healthcare fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a deeper understanding of the scope and impact of healthcare fraud, and identify potential ways to prevent it in the future.
